goal: Publish a verified cumulative VII release whose slider data, first images and tab changes load materially faster without sacrificing freshness, stable RTL geometry or prior capabilities.

intent_model.literal_request: Implement the agreed slider speed architecture, back it with QQQAAA, lock it against regression and publish it.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Visitors see useful verified slider content and images quickly on first view and tab changes across worlds, with no blank or misleading state.
likely_rejections: Only one slider or viewport improves.
The public version differs from the tested build.
The slider is faster but sweeps or breaks on mobile.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Add deterministic regression coverage and release gates for the complete shared family.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A regression fixture must fail on the old behavior and pass on the candidate.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Publication is conditional on all required gates and exact post-deploy checks.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Record exact deployment identity, rollback and public natural-destination evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The selected slider immediately shows retained verified content or a proportionate loading state.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Select a tab or move through the rail.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the selected place or continue to the adjacent rail items.

natural_destination: The exact public build at https://vii.spaplus.co/ and its vacation, holiday, spa and event slider routes.

facts.claim: The current home-deals API response performs settings, catalog-index, snapshot and curation work on each no-store request.
facts.evidence: app/api/vii/home-deals/route.ts and public Server-Timing samples from 2026-11-11.

facts.claim: Deferred rails currently prevent first spa and event images from receiving eager priority and home live cards do not pass priority.
The current rail pacer mounts four cards then two per animation/idle batch.

assumptions.claim: The existing edge delivery layer can safely cache bounded discovery GET view models without caching booking transactions.
assumptions.validation: Inspect the current worker routing and tests before any edge change.

in_scope: Discovery request deduplication and bounded stale-while-revalidate
viewport-aware rail rendering without geometry changes
out_of_scope: Changing booking authority or final availability confirmation
Domain, database, binding or permission changes
invariants: v875 holiday minimum-stay and amenity parity remains intact
Every snap wrapper exists before card content is progressively mounted
Expired source offers never become accepted discovery data
Booking and mutation requests remain live and uncached
Original PUBLIC environment, DB, uploads and managed redirects remain unchanged

requirements.statement: Initial visible slider data and images appear without avoidable client idle delays.
Tab changes reuse or prefetch verified discovery data and never issue duplicate concurrent requests for the same key.
Discovery caching remains bounded by source expiry and cannot alter booking-time authority.
RTL geometry, arrows, loading, failure, retry and responsive behavior remain correct across affected worlds.

The exact cumulative candidate passes the full local regression suite, scoped slider and edge gates, and a bounded public post-deploy smoke with rollback ready. The broad production QQQAAA matrix is excluded after it contributed sustained uncancelled load during the 524 incident.
requirements.source: User publication authorization plus v876 incident containment

acceptance_checks.setup: Cold and warm public or compiled slider view at 390px and desktop.
acceptance_checks.action: Load the section and inspect network plus rendered cards.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Useful first cards render immediately from seed or bounded discovery data and the first visible images receive high priority after activation.

acceptance_checks.setup: A slider with multiple tabs and an empty browser memory cache.
acceptance_checks.action: Switch tabs, return to a prior tab and reload.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One in-flight request per key, no stale result commit, cached verified return is immediate and selected state persists as designed.

acceptance_checks.setup: Expired or invalid discovery payload and a booking action.
acceptance_checks.action: Attempt discovery reuse and then booking verification.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Expired discovery is rejected or refreshed; booking remains uncached and revalidates against its authoritative endpoint.

acceptance_checks.setup: Slow or failed slider refresh with a prior verified result.
acceptance_checks.action: Wait through failure and use retry.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Prior verified content remains coherent, busy feedback is visible, duplicate action is blocked and retry restores a single usable state.

acceptance_checks.setup: Vacation, holiday, spa and event rails at 390px and desktop.
acceptance_checks.action: Use every tab and both directional controls through the true ends.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No rail sweep, blank band, clipped card, unreachable end or layout overflow occurs.

acceptance_checks.setup: Frozen clean candidate and retained predecessor release.
acceptance_checks.action: Run release gates, deploy once and open the exact public build.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All required gates pass, exact identity is public, representative scenarios pass and rollback artifacts remain available.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, testing and one qualified public release are authorized. No unrelated production mutation is authorized.
